value.message: At 4 months he's not quite ready for Ferber yet - it's built for 6 months and up because under that age babies genuinely still need night feeds and their sleep rhythms aren't consolidated enough for the method to work. Two more months. In the meantime, watch for him falling asleep only at the breast or with rocking - that's the pattern Ferber fixes, and spotting it now means you'll know exactly what you're targeting when he hits 6 months.
